title: U.S. House · Indiana's 4th District
area: West-central Indiana, including Lafayette, Terre Haute, and Kokomo

context.text: Incumbent Jim Baird won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary over Craig Haggard and John Piper with 60.5% of the vote. Drew Cox won a crowded eight-candidate Democratic primary with about 30% of the vote. This was the most-contested primary field of any Indiana district in 2026, with eleven candidates total.

candidates.name: Jim Baird
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary with 60.5% of the vote, over Craig Haggard and John Piper

summary.text: Jim Baird is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for Indiana's 4th District, first elected in 2018. He previously served as Putnam County commissioner and in the Indiana House of Representatives.

background.text: Born in Fountain County, Indiana, in 1945. Earned bachelor's and master's degrees in animal science from Purdue University (1967, 1969) and a doctorate in monogastric nutrition from the University of Kentucky (1975).
Served in the U.S. Army from 1969 to 1972.
Worked as a farmer and small business owner. Served as Putnam County commissioner from 2006 to 2010, and in the Indiana House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018.

Serves on the House Committee on Agriculture (as Vice Chair of the Conservation, Research, and Biotechnology subcommittee), the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and the Committee on Foreign Affairs in the 119th Congress.

record.text: Assigned to the House Committee on Agriculture, the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and the Committee on Foreign Affairs for the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

candidates.name: Drew Cox
candidates.ballotNote: Won an eight-candidate May 5, 2026 Democratic primary with about 30% of the vote

summary.text: Drew Cox is the Democratic nominee for Indiana's 4th District, a Marine Corps veteran and music instructor at Purdue University.

background.text: Son of a public school teacher and a fourth-generation farmer; honorably discharged from the U.S. Marine Corps in 2012.
Used the GI Bill to attend Indiana University and earned a doctorate in music from the University of Illinois.
Serves as a Visiting Instructor at Purdue University; member of the Marine Corps League and American Legion Post 11.
Completed an Associate of Applied Science in Energy Technology from Ivy Tech Community College.

priorities.text: Says Congress has neglected tariffs, foreign conflict, and data-center regulation, creating an affordability crisis.
priorities.quote: We demand an affordable economy. Congress has neglected its duties with regard to tariffs, the war in Iran, and by allowing data centers to be unregulated.

priorities.text: Says he wants a single-payer healthcare system that prioritizes people over corporate profit.
priorities.quote: We need a single payer healthcare system that puts people over profits.

priorities.text: Says he wants ICE held to the same standards as other law enforcement agencies, including producing judicial warrants.

positions.summary: Campaign website says he will fight to pass a Medicare for All-style act to guarantee healthcare as a right, not a commodity.
Campaign website says he will fight for the Raise the Wage Act to raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour, indexed to inflation.
Campaign website says he will fight to pass the ROAD to Housing Act to ease zoning restrictions and support modular housing construction.
Campaign website says he supports the For the 99.5 Percent Act and a more progressive tax system with higher brackets for top earners and closing corporate tax loopholes.
Campaign website says he opposes sending further U.S. military aid or weapons to Israel and would refuse AIPAC campaign contributions.
positions.quote: not a single cent, or a single weapon, whether offensive or "defensive", should be sent from the United States to Israel

positions.summary: Campaign website calls for abolishing ICE and replacing it with what he describes as a fair, equitable immigration system.

summary.text: David Bokash is an independent candidate for Indiana's 4th District. Ballotpedia reports no campaign contributions and he has not completed a Candidate Connection survey or documented campaign themes as of this writing.
